class_definitions.DISPOSITION: states the demotion, withdrawal or death, or quotes the withdrawn clause in order to withdraw it
class_definitions.CAVEAT: flags the value as unverified or not to be used; no quantitative use
class_definitions.CITATION_RULE: a rule to quote the paper's value verbatim; no quantitative use
class_definitions.VERBATIM_CITATION: the paper's own sentence quoted verbatim
class_definitions.PAPER_VALUE_REPORTED: reports the paper's pooled value as the paper's finding; qualitative
class_definitions.FROZEN_DEPOSITED_QUANTITATIVE: deposited registration text that uses the value as a sigma or gate; frozen, superseded by a dated correction of record
class_definitions.REGISTERED_OPTION_QUANTITATIVE: a registered, still-open option that carries the value as a gate width
class_definitions.DATED_RECORD_QUANTITATIVE: a dated research/readout record that uses the value quantitatively; predates or ignores the disposition
class_definitions.LIVE_QUANTITATIVE: a live plan or index sentence that still uses the value quantitatively with no disposition note
class_definitions.DRAFT_COPY: an amendment draft or decision-sheet copy of a docs/43 line classified separately
class_definitions.ARCHIVE_COPY: an archived pre-amendment copy of docs/43
class_definitions.GENERATED_COPY: a generated artefact quoting other lines
class_definitions.DATA_TABLE_VALUE: a cell of a published data table
class_definitions.UNRELATED_NUMBER: the digits are a different quantity
class_definitions.UNRELATED_QUANTITY: a 0.12 eV/V quantity unrelated to the intercept spread or the code floor
